verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware product backed by an ecosystem of SDKs, the ykman CLI, and the YubiEnterprise REST API, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no MCP server exists: the runtime probe reports no MCP endpoint and that mcp.yubico.com does not resolve. The CLI, SDKs and REST API are only building blocks a developer could use to build one, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
